title: Inhibitors of dermatan sulfate epimerase 1 decreased accumulation of glycosaminoglycans in mucopolysaccharidosis type I fibroblasts.
authors: Maccarana, Marco; Li, Binjie; Li, Honglian; Fang, Jianping; Yu, Mingjia; Li, Jin-Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黏多糖贮积症中硫酸皮肤素差向异构酶抑制剂，虽涉及酶-底物对接，但核心是酶-小分子药物筛选，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Genetic deficiency of alpha-L-iduronidase causes mucopolysaccharidosis type I (MPS-I) disease, due to accumulation of glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) including chondroitin/dermatan sulfate (CS/DS) and heparan sulfate (HS) in cells. Currently, patients are treated by infusion of recombinant iduronidase or by hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. An alternative approach is to reduce the L-iduronidase substrate, through limiting the biosynthesis of iduronic acid. Our earlier study demonstrated that ebselen attenuated GAGs accumulation in MPS-I cells, through inhibiting iduronic acid producing enzymes. However, ebselen has multiple pharmacological effects, which prevents its application for MPS-I. Thus, we continued the study by looking for novel inhibitors of dermatan sulfate epimerase 1 (DS-epi1), the main responsible enzyme for production of iduronic acid in CS/DS chains. Based on virtual screening of chemicals towards chondroitinase AC, we constructed a library with 1,064 compounds that were tested for DS-epi1 inhibition. Seventeen compounds were identified to be able to inhibit 27%-86% of DS-epi1 activity at 10 muM. Two compounds were selected for further investigation based on the structure properties. The results show that both inhibitors had a comparable level in inhibition of DS-epi1while they had negligible effect on HS epimerase. The two inhibitors were able to reduce iduronic acid biosynthesis in CS/DS and GAG accumulation in WT and MPS-I fibroblasts. Docking of the inhibitors into DS-epi1 structure shows high affinity binding of both compounds to the active site. The collected data indicate that these hit compounds may be further elaborated to a potential lead drug used for attenuation of GAGs accumulation in MPS-I patients.
abstract_zh: α-L-艾杜糖苷酶的遗传缺陷导致黏多糖贮积症I型（MPS-I）疾病，这是由于细胞中糖胺聚糖（GAGs）包括硫酸软骨素/硫酸皮肤素（CS/DS）和硫酸乙酰肝素（HS）的积累所致。目前，患者通过输注重组艾杜糖苷酶或造血干细胞移植进行治疗。另一种方法是减少L-艾杜糖苷酶的底物，通过限制艾杜糖醛酸的生物合成。我们先前的研究表明，依布硒啉通过抑制艾杜糖醛酸产生酶，减轻了MPS-I细胞中GAGs的积累。然而，依布硒啉具有多种药理效应，这阻碍了其在MPS-I中的应用。因此，我们继续研究，寻找硫酸皮肤素表异构酶1（DS-epi1）的新型抑制剂，该酶是CS/DS链中产生艾杜糖醛酸的主要酶。基于对软骨素酶AC的化学物质虚拟筛选，我们构建了一个包含1,064种化合物的库，并测试了它们对DS-epi1的抑制作用。鉴定出17种化合物在10 μM浓度下能抑制27%-86%的DS-epi1活性。根据结构特性，选择两种化合物进行进一步研究。结果表明，这两种抑制剂在抑制DS-epi1方面具有相当的水平，而对HS表异构酶的影响可忽略不计。这两种抑制剂能够减少WT和MPS-I成纤维细胞中CS/DS的艾杜糖醛酸生物合成以及GAG积累。将抑制剂对接至DS-epi1结构中显示，这两种化合物均与活性位点具有高亲和力结合。收集的数据表明，这些命中化合物可能进一步开发为潜在的前导药物，用于减轻MPS-I患者中GAGs的积累。
